# platform-orchestrator_module_draft (Resource)

Manages an editable Module Draft with immutable authoring revisions. Saving does not reserve SemVer or execute a deployment. Publish only after a separate apply has saved the definition you reviewed. Destroy discards an open Draft, retains authoring history and never deletes a published Module Version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "platform-orchestrator_module_draft" "storage" {
  module_id        = "storage"
  authoring_key    = "storage-1.2.0-authoring"
  semantic_version = "1.2.0"
  reason           = "Prepare the next storage implementation"
  status           = "open"

  definition = jsonencode({
    module_source      = "inline"
    module_source_code = "output \"name\" { value = \"first attempt\" }"
    module_inputs      = {}
    module_params      = {}
    provider_mapping   = {}
    dependencies       = {}
    coprovisioned      = []
    output_schema = {
      type       = "object"
      properties = { name = { type = "string" } }
    }
  })
}

# Apply edits while open. After reviewing the stored revision, change only
# status to "published" and reason to your publication reason, then apply again.
# This creates Proposed. Promotion to Default is a separate lifecycle action.
# Use a new authoring_key when starting another session after this one closes.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authoring_key` (String) Stable identity of this authoring session. Keep it unchanged for retries; use a new key when replacing a closed Draft.
- `definition` (String) Complete JSON authoring definition, excluding semantic_version. Accepts source, module inputs/parameters, provider mappings, dependencies, coprovisioned, output_schema, optional resource_type_version and release notes. External source_revision may be omitted while editing but is required at publication. artifact_digest remains optional and must be omitted for inline source.
- `module_id` (String)
- `reason` (String) Input reason for the next save or publication, not a projection of historical reasons.
- `semantic_version` (String) Planned SemVer, editable while open and reserved only at publication.

### Optional

- `status` (String) Initially open. Change to published to publish the exact stored revision, or discarded to close authoring. Closed Drafts cannot be reopened or edited.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable authoring Draft UUID.
- `published_version_uuid` (String) Immutable Proposed Version UUID after publication; publication never promotes it to Default.
- `resource_version` (Number) Exact authoring revision used for optimistic concurrency. Changes when the Draft is saved or closed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import platform-orchestrator_module_draft.storage 'storage/01234567-89ab-4cde-8f01-23456789abcd/storage-1.2.0-authoring'
```
